name: moai-ref-jev-question-design
description: Question-design reference for the gated TypeSafe System One judgment capability. How to author typed questions that return useful, honest answers: compute the question in code, always admit a no-match answer, keep the supplied state small, phrase noul questions so both polarities are expressible. Carries the question-design rules ONLY — never the call path; where and how to reach the capability is the MCP catalogue's concern.
